rows.name:
Having escaped with their lives, they're low on medicine.[XENO:n ]
Without it, Gorman will suffer.[XENO:n ]
Gather the ingredients for Gorman.

Obtain 5 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Glowing Lampus Fluid[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Lampus on the Giant God's Leg.
Report to Olga.

You delivered the ingredients for the insomnia[XENO:n ]
medicine, so Gorman won't have to go without sleep.

Tatsu's grandson broke his friend's treasured toy.[XENO:n ]
Repairing it requires Sticky Spide Thread.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials to fix the toy.

Obtain 3 lengths of [System:Color name=item ]Sticky Spide Thread[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Spides on the Giant God's Leg.
Report to Tatsu.
Give the toy to Kiroro.
Report to Tatsu.

You repaired the broken toy[XENO:n ]
and mended their friendship as well.

Pamu lost his parents and has been downhearted.[XENO:n ]
Matryona wants to make a picture book to cheer him up[XENO:n ]
but can't write the story. Speak to the novelist Ewan.
Speak to Ewan.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Ponio Black Manes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Field Ponios on the Giant God's Leg.
Speak to Ewan.
Report to Matryona.

Ewan gained some hope and began writing the story.[XENO:n ]
Work on the picture book is finally underway.

Matryona inspired Ewan to begin writing.[XENO:n ]
His story apparently requires paint made[XENO:n ]
from Sharp Cranberries. Gather some.[XENO:n ]

Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Sharp Cranberries[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Report to Ewan.
Give the paints to Matryona.
Report to Ewan.

Ewan's resolve was apparent,[XENO:n ]
and his relationship with Matryona improved.

You saw a future in which Pamu drowns.[XENO:n ]
It will happen if you give him the book as it is.[XENO:n ]
Change that unwanted future and save his life!

Near Raguel Lake on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Lake Drop[/System:Color].
Report to Matryona.
Give the picture book to Pamu.

You gave Pamu a picture book with a few changes.[XENO:n ]
He will no longer drown.

You saw a future in which Pamu drowns.[XENO:n ]
It seems to happen because he goes to the river alone.[XENO:n ]
Keep him from going alone and save his life!

Near the Tranquil Grotto on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Medicinal Herb[/System:Color].
Speak to Arda.
Report to Matryona.
Give the picture book to Pamu.

You gave Arda medicine for back pain,[XENO:n ]
so Pamu won't go near the river alone anymore.

Beastmen stole the laundry while it was drying outside.[XENO:n ]
The residents will run short of clothes at this rate.[XENO:n ]
Retrieve their clothes from the beastmen.

At Tirkin Headquarters on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Everyone's Clothes[/System:Color].
Report to Gorman.

You recovered the clothes from the beastmen[XENO:n ]
who stole them while they were drying.

The residents can no longer catch fish, a staple food.[XENO:n ]
A monster that settled in Raguel Lake seems responsible.[XENO:n ]
Defeat it to help feed the residents.

Near Raguel Lake on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Voracious Grog[/System:Color].
Report to Tatsu.

You eliminated the gluttonous monster in Raguel Lake[XENO:n ]
and averted a food crisis.

Man-eating wolves are closing in on a woman bathing.[XENO:n ]
Rescue her before she's attacked.

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Ferocious Volff[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
at the waterfall in Gaur Plain.
Speak to the woman.

You rescued the woman who had come to bathe alone.[XENO:n ]
She probably won't come here alone again.

There are supposedly inexhaustible crystals near camp.[XENO:n ]
They should be in a small cave to the right[XENO:n ]
as you leave camp, but[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Search the area around the ether deposit.
Report to Earnest.

You went where you were told but found ordinary crystals.[XENO:n ]
It seems Earnest tricked you.

There are supposedly crystals in a cave facing[XENO:n ]
Raguel Lake southeast of the bridge, but[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Is he telling the truth this time?
Search the area around the ether deposit.
Report to Earnest.

You trusted him once more, but it was another lie.[XENO:n ]
Earnest has tricked you twice now.

Earnest seems to have a reason for all his lies.[XENO:n ]
His friend's grave is on a cliff north of Kasharpa Falls.[XENO:n ]
Lay the flowers he gave you on the grave.
Place the flowers on the grave.

North of Kasharpa Falls on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Arrogant Tirkin[/System:Color].
Report to Earnest.

You lifted the dark cloud hanging over[XENO:n ]
Earnest. He probably won't lie again.

Grelee and the others were looking for dinner ingredients[XENO:n ]
when their companion Baldo got separated from them.[XENO:n ]
Find Baldo, who has a terrible sense of direction.

Find Baldo near Raguel Lake[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Report to Grelee.

You found Baldo after he got separated.[XENO:n ]
He'll be more careful not to stray from now on.

Baldo wants to thank someone. He needs two[XENO:n ]
ingredients to make a gift using a secret passed[XENO:n ]
down among the Nopon. Gather them for him.

Near Zax Guidepost on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain a [System:Color name=item ]Tokilos' Egg[/System:Color].

Near Windy Cave on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain a [System:Color name=item ]Pandora Mushroom[/System:Color].
Report to Baldo.

You were the ones Baldo wanted to thank.[XENO:n ]
You accepted his gift for now.

Baldo decided to thank you on his own this[XENO:n ]
time. He went off alone to find flowers[XENO:n ]
and hasn't returned. Find Baldo again.

Find Baldo near the top of Crevasse Waterfall[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

Go above the large waterfall on the Giant God's Leg[XENO:n ]
and obtain [System:Color name=item ]Ether Wisdom[/System:Color].
Report to Baldo.

Baldo seems to have blundered yet again.[XENO:n ]
He promised not to overdo it on his own anymore.

The kind Mythical Empress is enraged by her child's death.[XENO:n ]
She has run amok and is damaging the surrounding area.[XENO:n ]
Go to her nest and defeat her, however painful it is.

Near Zax Guidepost on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Mythical Empress[/System:Color].
Report to Grelee.

You defeated the kindhearted Mythical Empress.[XENO:n ]
The legend has finally come to an end.

Collect a single blossoming flower for Durand from[XENO:n ]
the Tephra Cave ruins.

Near Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Ancient Lily[/System:Color].
Report to Durand.

The Ancient Lily has been delivered to Durand,[XENO:n ]
but who will be the final recipient?

Durand can't deliver the Ancient Lily.[XENO:n ]
Two gigantic beasts are rampaging in Tephra Cave.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them for him.

In the Queen Spider's Den in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Void Zanden[/System:Color].

In the Queen Spider's Den in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Firework Geldesia[/System:Color].
Report to Durand.

You eliminated the giant beasts in Tephra Cave[XENO:n ]
and made the road to Colony 9 safe.

Some High Entia reportedly fled to Satorl Marsh.[XENO:n ]
They may be facing a food shortage.[XENO:n ]
Deliver food to those who took refuge in Satorl.

Deliver the supplies[XENO:n ]
to Seagal in Satorl Marsh.

Supplies from camp reached the Satorl refugees.[XENO:n ]
That should make life in Satorl a little easier.

Monsters are causing trouble by crowding people.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Leg Arduns[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the Homs traveller's request.[XENO:n ]
Maybe the monsters were just friendly.

The vast Gaur Plain is home to many creatures.[XENO:n ]
Some mischievous monsters are causing trouble.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Maker Bunnits[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the Homs traveller's request.[XENO:n ]
Perhaps there will be a little less mischief now.

Fast, fierce monsters roam Gaur Plain.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them to make the route safe.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Field Ponios[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the Homs traveller's request.[XENO:n ]
Travellers can now pass safely.

Howling can be heard while camping out.[XENO:n ]
Worried travellers can't rest properly.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters responsible for the howling.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Leg Volff[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the Homs traveller's request.[XENO:n ]
They no longer have to tremble with fear while camping.

Someone went to see fireflies and found many monsters.[XENO:n ]
They've asked you to defeat them before anyone gets hurt.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Basin Antols[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The elderly man can go see the fireflies now.

Someone wants to look for survivors, but can't[XENO:n ]
because of the Machine God Soldiers.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the Machine God Soldiers so they can search.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Machine God Soldiers M64[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
They can now go looking for survivors.

No one knows if there are any survivors, but Tirkins[XENO:n ]
have grown too numerous lately and could harm them.[XENO:n ]
You've been asked to reduce their numbers.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Brave Tirkins[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
If there are survivors, they'll be a little safer now.

You've been asked to eliminate a threat[XENO:n ]
before it endangers the people at camp.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monster.

At Raguel Lake on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]White Eduardo[/System:Color] (thunderstorms only).

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The threat was eliminated before it reached the camp.

A monster is rampaging between Viliera Hill[XENO:n ]
and Sky Stage on the Giant God's Leg.[XENO:n ]
Defeat it so someone can attend to an important matter.

Near Sky Stage on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Rampaging Andante[/System:Color].

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You eliminated the dangerous rampaging monster.

A group went looking for food and found a monster.[XENO:n ]
It's a favourite spot, so they want it back.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monster.

In the Upper Level of the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Trainer Hamelin[/System:Color] north of Spiral Valley.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The child's favourite spot is free of monsters now.

An unusually large beastman was among the others.[XENO:n ]
They've asked you to defeat it before it attacks camp.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monster.

At Tirkin Headquarters on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
defeat the [System:Color name=item ]Vagrant Alfead[/System:Color].

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Defeating the monster has put their minds at ease.

Someone wants to serve the people at camp a hearty[XENO:n ]
meal for a change. Gather the ingredients for them.

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Grog Thigh Meat[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Grogs on the Giant God's Leg.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Fertile Flamii Eggs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Flamii on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
The people at camp should have a little more energy now.

They fled with only the clothes on their backs.[XENO:n ]
Gather materials for making more clothes.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Tirkin Crests[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from spear-wielding Tirkins on the Giant God's Leg.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Tirkin Tail Feathers[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from bow-wielding Tirkins on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
They should be able to make clothes now.

To bring the people at camp a little happiness,[XENO:n ]
gather a Lucky Bunnit Sapling.

Obtain a [System:Color name=item ]Lucky Bunnit Sapling[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Slugger Bunnits on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Hopefully the sapling will bring them some happiness.

Someone wants charms for those living in hardship.[XENO:n ]
Obtain the materials a Nopon told them about.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Vamp Wisdom Teeth[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Vamps on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Making the charms should give them peace of mind.

The camp food is poorly seasoned.[XENO:n ]
Better seasoning would make meals enjoyable.[XENO:n ]
Gather the collectables.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Clear Almonds[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Mealtimes should be enjoyable from now on.

Someone wants an insect for their downhearted[XENO:n ]
younger sister to play with. Gather the collectables.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Moth Crawlers[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Having something to play with should cheer her up.

A woman dropped her late boyfriend's keepsake fleeing[XENO:n ]
near the bridge. Find it, as she can't go herself.

Near Raguel Bridge on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]One-Wing Bird Necklace[/System:Color].

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You returned her late boyfriend's keepsake.

The wind blew away a keepsake of time with friends.[XENO:n ]
Its owner is too frail to search, so find it for them.

Near Gaur Plain on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Group Message Fragment[/System:Color].

You fulfilled the camp resident's request.[XENO:n ]
You safely returned the keepsake of their friends.
